title: sdl: Update to 3.4.16
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

This PR updates SDL to the current latest stable version (3.4.16).
https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/tag/release-3.4.16

The updating process has been done by me and the update script.

- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119465

(context: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120373#issuecomment-4734737598 )
- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115667,
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/121539
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/123405

(context: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/14961#issuecomment-4766857330 , see also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112658 )
- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119785

(see https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/commit/2fd15d9e0d48afedd3f87795b9688560a6bdb7a4 )
- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119817

(see https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/commit/ca67f19c8f161cfff26ee52c57ff2ae8b9d42ef6 )

This PR has been tested on Windows with the following controllers:
- A cheap controller from AliExpress
- DualShock 4
- Xbox One controller
- JoyCons
- DualShock 4 with 8BitDo adapter

This PR also ported the changes from https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/commit/14c31ee12a6456db78ad3ff2f100391416ee38a0 to make joypad accelerometer work on iOS.
